notes: Unlike most adjectives in French, 'bon marché' is invariable. You never add an 's' to make it plural, even when describing multiple items.

Be careful: while 'bon marché' suggests a good deal and is usually positive, the word 'pas cher' is more common in everyday speech. Use 'bon marché' when you want to sound slightly more formal or emphatic about the value.
